A reasonable amount may be paid or set aside each month 8 for necessary expenses of the trust, not to exceed ten fifty 9 dollars per month without court approval. 10 EXPLANATION 11 The inclusion of this explanation does not constitute agreement with 12 the explanation’s substance by the members of the general assembly. 13 This bill relates to medical income assistance trust fees. 14 The bill increases the amount that may be paid or set aside 15 each month for necessary trust expenses without court approval 16 for beneficiaries from $10 to $50. 17 -1- LSB 1690HV (1) 91 cm/jh 1/ 1
